title: Welcome to Randomism
description: An introduction to the Randomism JSON-driven blog.

blocks.content: Randomism is a static blog where each article is a JSON file. Page copy lives in data, and the app only validates and renders blocks through a registry.

content.alt: Abstract teal and cream geometric shapes representing Randomism

blocks.content: Articles are listed on the home page when marked published, sorted by publish date. Drafts stay in the data folder but never appear publicly.
